maximum_allowed_claim: The project constructs a reversible source-locatable operational event representation for the analysed GQ39 data.
evidence: R1 table audit; stable event IDs; raw-code and missingness preservation
required_qualification: Does not resolve every historical jianzipu token or competing image parse

maximum_allowed_claim: Previous gesture information improves grouped held-out prediction beyond context controls for the registered targets.
evidence: T1 R2 improves 10/10 pieces; T2 field ablation
prohibited_extrapolation: Causal or cognitive status of gesture features

maximum_allowed_claim: Prior right-hand direction is independently informative for T2.
evidence: Drop-RH ΔNLL +0.0287 with 95% piece-bootstrap interval above zero; 9/10 pieces
required_qualification: Previous-event only; documented a/b direction mapping
prohibited_extrapolation: Universal right-hand feature or present-event leakage

maximum_allowed_claim: Sparse factorization is more economical than atomic or flat high-cardinality encoding for these tasks.
evidence: NLL; encoded columns; UNK rates; Pareto comparison
required_qualification: Ten piece groups and two targets

maximum_allowed_claim: Separate tier main effects outperform information-matched flat conjunction for T1.
required_qualification: T2 interval crosses zero; no cognitive tier claim

maximum_allowed_claim: Explicit cross-tier associations are not justified by the current fit-cost evidence.
evidence: R4−R4M intervals cross zero for both targets
required_qualification: Absence of evidence in this design
prohibited_extrapolation: Association structures are unnecessary in language phonology

maximum_allowed_claim: T1 return classes remain descriptive source categories but are not computationally resolved.
evidence: Zero winning-label recall; concentrated worst-case loss
required_qualification: Primary six-way result retained; possible post-primary merge sensitivity
prohibited_extrapolation: Established independent contrasts or proof they should be merged

maximum_allowed_claim: Cross-domain evidence supports empirical burden for structural complexity and a stricter recoverability criterion than raw predictability.
evidence: Factorization/association ablations; class-specific failures; sensitivity checks
required_qualification: External pressure test and methodological constraint

maximum_allowed_claim: The study does not establish that guqin has a phonology equivalent to natural-language phonology.
prohibited_extrapolation: Guqin is language; shared cognitive grammar

maximum_allowed_claim: An outcome-informed T2 right-hand-direction-only model retains a large R5 advantage with low cost.
evidence: 31 median columns; piece-macro NLL 0.2075; Δ vs R5 −0.0815
